wiki.title: Floren
wiki.text:
Floren are a plant-like sentient race that live in the Floren Forest. Some of white pigmentation can be found in Snowhill.

article_facts: fact:location: Floren Forest is a hidden valley that has been home to the Floren for many generations, once a beautiful place. | This hidden valley has been home to the Floren for many generations. (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=904)

fact:combat: Hidden Floren has a power-up that can damage the opponent even when the player loses a battle. | through the power-up on Hidden Floren (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=143)

fact:event: Something evil has corrupted the Floren Forest and the Floren, who previously greeted travelers friendly, now attack on sight. | Now they attack on sight! (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=904)

fact:npc: The Floren are magical beings who are in touch with nature and whose bodies are made of leaves and branches. | Their bodies are made up of leaves and branches. (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=904)
